title: Normalization μHE[n] = a·μH[n]: local integrability of g·e and ∫ f(g·e) dμH[n] = (c∫f dμ)·e for μ = Hⁿ⌞g (supplied proof, steps 2 and 5)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ. There is a real constant c > 0 with the following property. Let Q ∈ ℕ, let μ be a measure on ℝ^P, let g : ℝ^P → ℝ be Borel measurable with g ≥ 0, and let e ∈ ℝ^Q. Assume μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K and μ = μHE[n].withDensity(x ↦ ofReal(g(x))). Then (i) x ↦ g(x)e is locally integrable with respect to the Hausdorff measure μH[n] on ℝ^P; and (ii) for every continuous compactly supported f : ℝ^P → ℝ, ∫ f(x)·(g(x)e) dμH[n](x) = (c·∫ f dμ)·e.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (Q : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (e : Euclid Q), Measurable g → (∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K ≠ ∞) → μ = (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (g x)) → LocallyIntegrable (fun x => g x • e) μH[(n : ℝ)] ∧ ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → ∫ x, f x • (g x • e) ∂μH[(n : ℝ)] = (c * ∫ x, f x ∂μ) • e
